closed note 5434767 (near Középső-Ferencváros, 9th district) / Created 3 days ago by Lovran
Here is a crossover from left to right in the direction to the center. / Updated 2 days ago by balint36
That's a temporary crossover because the terminus is closed due to railway construction. / Updated 2 days ago by Lovran
Yes, I know. But is this a reason not to edit it ? The railway construction will continue until late 2027 at the earliest. / Updated 2 days ago by balint36
Of course it is. / Updated 2 days ago by Lovran
No, that is only your private opinion. Of course it is not. You do not comply with the general rules of OSM, which say: "A 16-month duration is not a reason to hold off. OpenStreetMap (OSM) maps the world as it exists today, and at least 16 months is considered a long-term change that should be documented." OSM Guidelines for Long-Term ChangesMap the current reality: "If a road is closed or a building is demolished for over a year, the map should reflect that right now." / Updated 2 days ago by balint36
Whatever that makes you feel good. If it makes you happy that you can tell how we should mapping despite the fact that the Hungarian mapping community does not indicate such small temporary elements (which is just a portable track section, by the way) on a less important network. But however, who I am to opress you from mapping this but I wouldn't be surprised if someone would delete sooner or later. / Updated 2 days ago by balint36
Oh, I almost forget, it's really good that you mention that it's close for 16 moths and according the OSM wiki the closed road (or tramway, whatever) should be tag but I have two problems. First: The text that you quoted states that the road (or tramway, whatever) should be taged, not the portable pieces. Second: How comes the 16-month duration? The closure dure until 9 august. https://bkk.hu/menetrend-utazastervezes/forgalmi-hirek/nem-hajt-be-a-kozvagohid-h-vegallomasra-a-2-es-es-a-24-es-villamos-julius-8-tol-augusztus-9-ig.16949/ I really apprectiate when the people want to be helpful, but I don't like that someone from abroad wants to state us what he/she thinks that is the correct however he/she does not aware of the background facts. / Updated 2 days ago by balint36
It there is no objection then I'd close this note without marking the temporary portable crossover because next Monday, the trams will return to their original Közvágóhíd terminus. / Resolved 2 days ago by Lovran

Az ösvényre (way #284723586) vonatkozóan ezek a táblák vannak kitéve: https://pic.easimer.net/share/wAjVw0ppap3vQHd2QTFATYX7p_85o9ukKC_vhd68zXi-HyN5G2OcQ4llpjHKx7d9fCE [Felső] Magánterület Idegeneknek belépni életveszélyes és tilos! [Alsó] Ismételten felhívjuk a lakosság figyelmét, hogy a kerítés előtti terület a PEMÜ Műanyagipari Zrt. magánterülete (lenti térképnek megfelelően), oda bejáró, avagy azon áthaladó személyes birtokháborítást követnek el. A kerítés előtti területen közlekedni balesetveszélyes, az ott bekövetkező személyi sérülésekért, vagyoni károsodásért a PEMÜ Zrt. nem vállal felelősséget. [térkép, amelyen a HRSZ 1373/1 területe ki van emelve, "PEMÜ MAGÁNTERÜLET" felirattal] Nem tudom, hogy a HRSZ 1373/1 tényleg a magánterületük, de ha az, akkor access=private illene, mert "the feature is not to be used by the public". / Updated 2 days ago by qstep
Köszi az infót. Kapott egy kis törődést a környék és az üzem területe: https://www.openstreetmap.org/changeset/186917424 / Updated 2 days ago by qstep
A way/284723586 ösvényre is private-et raktam mivel az egész terület magánterület. De ott is ki van táblázva, vagy csak a kerítés melletti lépcső/út? / Updated 2 days ago by easimer
A kerítés melletti lépcsőnél is ki van rakva tábla, de csak az "Idegeneknek belépni életveszélyes és tilos!", a másik nem.
